events.title: Demo v0.4.0 available now! A new fortress and artillery trains
events.summary: Demo v0.4.0 is available now on Steam! I've got five missions in the Comrade, Secrets Escape! demo now. Red Bastion is the new one, a fortress in the snow with Soviet banners, watchtowers and two gates. It goes second in the campaign. I've redone First Order's scenery too, and Killing Angles has new walls, gates, vats and guard towers. The flamethrowers throw more fire and the explosions are brighter. Turn on Realtime Lighting for the impact flashes. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45943997/1ec2b9ac2996170aa

events.title: Demo V0.3.1 available now! More guns, comrade
events.summary: Demo V0.3.1 is available now on Steam! I've just released the update with two new towers to help hold back the horde. There’s a Machine Gun Tower for pouring rounds into the horde, and a Slow Grenade Tower to slow the crowd down while your guns get to work. New tower power research lets you make your defenses stronger, and missions 3 and 4 now have explosive barrel stacks you can set off with a direct rocket hit. I've also made the research screen easier to read, with a pulsing border around upg

events.title: Comrade, unleash the big guns! Free Steam demo out now

If you enjoy it, a wishlist for the full game helps a lot. Thanks, comrade :) https://store.steampowered.com/app/4220070/

events.title: Free itch demo out now, new trailer + Steam playtest coming
events.summary: Hey everyone, I've just put the free demo for Comrade, Secrets Escape! up on itch. You can play it right in your desktop browser, no download needed. Build your kill zone, blast holes through escaping bio-experiments, and spend your Rubles on more ridiculous Soviet firepower. Excessive force is authorized. Play the free demo on itch It's still in development, so I'd really like to hear what you think. What felt good, what was confusing, what broke? Be honest. You can leave a comment here or send
